text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука and I are on the way
home from an
outing when we decide to
stop by the shopping
district.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow, it's so crowded.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Oh, there's a raffle. No wonder.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me, I'm pretty sure we
got a ticket
earlier when we were
shopping.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: We have a ticket, so why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.text:
They gave the ticket to you, so you
should be the
one to try!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Clang-clang! Clang-clang!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, would you look at that! We've got
a lucky
first-prize winner! You get to
walk away with the
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text: Oh... That bell sounds so familiar...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe, it kind of takes me back.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Back in my hometown, there was
this little
race I ran in as a kid.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It was called the Kiddy Race. It was so
small and
informal, we didn't even have
a proper finish line.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Instead, one of the adults would ring a
handbell
when one of us finished.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It sounded exactly like the one the clerk
just rang.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
Then let's get first place and hear the bell
again!

text_block_list.text:
Get first place? Don't you mean "Выиграйте

first-prize"?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
Nope! You have to get first place just like you
did at the Kiddy Race!

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Is that right?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Are you sure I can use your ticket,
though?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll go get first
place, then!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She goes to the clerk, exchanges the
ticket, and
turns the handle on the raffle
spinner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
spinner's
opening...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp! I placed even higher than first?!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Is that even possible in a race, Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: I guess it's like breaking a record?

text_block_list.text: Breaking a record...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's a fun way to think of it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
What am I supposed to do with this
coupon,
though?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I've only ever gone on vacation with my
family, so
I don't know what to do...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
You can go with a friend too. Why not invite
someone?

text_block_list.text: Oh, that's certainly an idea...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Then... who should I invite? Vacations
are such
special occasions, after all...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hmm...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: You don't have to decide now.

text_block_list.text: That's true. In that case...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could hold on to this
coupon
for me, please?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
If I kept it, I'd constantly worry about
who I
should invite.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Once I've decided, I'll be sure to get it
from you.
Could you please keep it safe
until then?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! I got first place! Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a raffle, I'm so glad I got
first.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Well, it is a tasty-looking hamburger steak.

text_block_list.text: It certainly is.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But it's a bit much considering I've still
got dinner
at the dorm to think about...
So would you like to
split it with me?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... I was so close to winning first...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But wow, what an incredible amount of
carrots.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: What should I do with them all?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
Why don't you share them with the others at the
dorm?

text_block_list.text: Oh! That's a good idea. I'll do that.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Spe will be so excited when she
sees them.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh... Third place...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I guess I didn't have
enough luck
to take first today...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have asked Fukukitaru
for a good
luck charm first.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she has one that's meant to
boost
your luck for drawing fortune slips
and such.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I can't say for sure how effective it is,
though.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! It's the consolation
prize for
you—a pack of tissues.
text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Вы получили:
<itemname>
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I didn't even place in the top
three!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: This is terrible!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we need to start training right
away!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: It's okay! It's just a raffle!

text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah! Y-you're right.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sorry, I got a bit caught up in the moment.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm more than happy to, so I agree to
share the
hamburger steak with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We plop her third-prize carrot into a
shopping
bag, and head back to the
academy as we watch
the sun set
beyond the horizon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I help Сайленс Судзука carry her carrots
back to the
dorm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука looks quite crestfallen as
we head
home, gazing at the sun setting
beyond the
horizon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I do as she requests and take the coupon
for
safekeeping.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
